description: React component for managing and displaying permission schemes in the Mattermost admin console, including loading schemes, handling migration states, and rendering UI elements for permission scheme management.

classes.name: PermissionSchemesSettings
classes.description: React component class for permission schemes settings page, handling data loading, migration states, and rendering permission scheme UI.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads initial schemes and scheme teams, manages migration state.

methods.name: loadMoreSchemes
methods.description: Loads additional schemes when user requests more.

methods.name: teamOverrideSchemesMigrationView
methods.description: Determines the view for team override schemes based on migration and job status.

methods.name: teamOverrideUnavalableView
methods.description: Renders message when team override schemes are unavailable.

methods.name: renderTeamOverrideSchemes
methods.description: Renders the list of team override schemes or a message if none exist.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, displaying loading screen or permission schemes UI.
